name: fused_moving_avg_obs_fake_quant
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::fused_moving_avg_obs_fake_quant(Tensor self, Tensor observer_on, Tensor fake_quant_on, Tensor(a!) running_min, Tensor(b!) running_max, Tensor(c!) scale, Tensor(d!) zero_point, float averaging_const, int quant_min, int quant_max, int ch_axis, bool per_row_fake_quant=False, bool symmetric_quant=False) -> Tensor. Tests cover deterministic float32 per-tensor and per-row/per-channel observer and fake-quant combinations, symmetric/asymmetric qparams, a nontrivial channel axis, output values and non-aliasing, input non-mutation, and in-place running-stat, scale, and zero-point updates with storage/layout preservation. The current FlagGems implementation scalarizes vector state and ignores per_row_fake_quant/ch_axis, so the pinned native ATen per-row contract intentionally remains a deferred implementation mismatch.
